name: Mom Is Home
steps: Drag the trash into the dustbin.
Use the cockroach spray on the bugs.
Open the toilet door and clean the floor with the mop.
Use the air freshener to remove the bad smell.
Put the dirty dishes into the sink.
Put the dirty clothes into the washing machine.
Give the cake to the cat.
Select the three men and hide them under the table.
Cover the table with the banner.
Move the disco light into the toilet to complete the level.
